title: OpenAI and Anthropic in price war as Chinese AI rivals gain ground
summary: Tokens are the units of data processed by language models and are used to calculate many customers’ bills. Anthropic launched Opus 5 at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens—half the price of its Fable 5 model.
